data.why: The repo's examples/ folder only holds output CSVs (no input FASTA), and the app's own live NCBI-fetch path needs outbound network the sandboxed server does not have, so synthetic FASTA files cover the offline paste/upload workflow plus its validation error paths.

goals: Paste or upload a DNA template and generate ranked, order-ready PCR primer pairs for a target amplicon size range
Inspect each primer pair's Tm, GC content, and binding coordinates to judge balance between forward and reverse primers
Check hairpin, homodimer, and heterodimer predictions to flag primers at risk of poor amplification
Export a CSV of the top primer pairs to send to an oligo synthesis vendor
Retrieve a defined region of a sequence directly from an NCBI nucleotide accession by coordinates and strand, then design primers on it
Confirm that primers designed from a pasted sequence and from the same region fetched from NCBI agree

review.summary: The tree's goal, phases and tasks match the README's paste/upload → validate → Primer3 → Tm/GC/structure review → CSV export path, and nearly every cited screen I opened shows what its node claims. Before filing, it needs the NCBI fetch-and-confirm stage added as a node marked not reached, better evidence for the CSV export, and a few label and branch corrections.
